subject: Next steps: On-prem hardware handshake & upgrade windows
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@genomix-labs.com>, Mark Holden <mark.holden@bioworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: On-prem hardware handshake & upgrade windows

Hi Emily / Mark —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on the Private deployment (air-gapped / on‑prem) qualification items we discussed: 

1) Scope: Genomix intent is Private (on‑prem, no egress) with quarterly patch windows and a small reserved crew for hardware swaps.
2) Site inventory: we need full rack-level inventory (chassis, GPU make/model, NICs, BMC access, PDU type) — I attached a template for your ops team.
3) Spare parts / SLA: confirm on‑site spares counts (GPU spares, PSUs, spare NICs), and whether you have local vendor SLA for advance replacement.
4) Upgrade windows: please confirm preferred maintenance blackout windows and any calendar approvals required (change control CAB timings).
5) Upgrade path: do you want Redwood to push firmware/OS upgrades via a secure courier process, or will Genomix execute upgrades using our offline MOP?

Action items for Genomix: please fill and return the attached site-inventory-template.xlsx by EOD June 6. Also confirm maintenance blackout windows and any procurement lead contact (if different from Mark).

I’ve CC’d Marissa from our Deploy Ops team — she’ll be lead on the SOW/MOP side and will set up a technical follow-up once we have the inventory.

Attachments: [Attachment: site-inventory-template.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)]

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Dr. Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@genomix-labs.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Holden <mark.holden@bioworks.io>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: On-prem hardware handshake & upgrade windows

Thanks Sergio — appreciated the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Inventory timeline: we can complete the template and return it by end of day Monday, June 6. Our facilities lead (cc’d internally) will pull rack manifests.
- Patch cadence: quarterly is our preference; windows we prefer are Saturdays 02:00–06:00 PDT to minimize lab impact.
- Spares: we currently maintain 1 spare GPU per rack and a cross‑lab pool of 3 spare PSUs; I’ll confirm exact SKUs in the inventory.
- Remote-assisted upgrades: we cannot accept any outbound connections from the cluster. If Redwood is doing firmware/OS updates, we need an offline delivery MOP (signed) and an on‑site operator to run the steps.

We’ll include any required change control forms in the return. Also looping Mark (vendor procurement) to expedite.

Best,
Emily
Dr. Emily Zhou
Head of Infrastructure | Genomix Labs
emily.zhou@genomix-labs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: On-prem hardware handshake & upgrade windows (internal ops prep)

Sergio / Ben — internal ops follow-up before we send MOPs: 

1) Spare parts: confirm we have guidance on minimum spare GPU / PSU counts (Genomix said 1 spare GPU per rack). We should propose a recommended parts list and RMA SLA matrix.
2) Firmware & BIOS: because the site is air-gapped, we must produce an offline firmware bundle + SHA256 manifest and step-by-step MOP for the on‑site operator. I’ve started the template MOP and attached our checklist for their ops team to review.
3) Power / PDU: ask whether PDU is switched and if we can schedule power cycling. Need cabinet RU and power capacity in the inventory.
4) Test windows & rollback: propose a 30‑minute test window per rack with immediate rollback plan (hot-swap PSUs, rollback kernel procedure).

Suggested next step: schedule a 60-minute technical call (Solutions Eng + Genomix infra + our Deploy Ops) to walk the inventory once they return it — propose Tue Jun 8 or Wed Jun 9.

Attachment: [Attachment: redwood-onprem-checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Marissa Cole
Deploy Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

(Internal note: Ben — can you draft a short spare-parts recommendation and RMA SLAs we can share?)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@genomix-labs.com>, Mark Holden <mark.holden@bioworks.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: On-prem hardware handshake & upgrade windows

Emily / Mark — thanks for the quick turnaround commitment. A few operational confirmations from our side: 

• Spare parts recommendation (high level): 1 spare GPU per 4 racks (ops pool), 1 spare PSU per rack, 2 spare NIC modules per cluster. We’ll provide SKU-level recs once we see the inventory.
• RMA / replacement SLA: for on‑site swaps we typically align to vendor next‑business-day replacement; for long‑lead GPU replacements we can include an advance replacement in the SOW at cost.
• Offline upgrade MOP: we will provide an offline bundle (signed manifest) + step-by-step runbook. Redwood’s engineer will join the session as an observer; the on‑site operator executes all commands per your requirement.

Please confirm PO timeline / procurement path — if you can share a draft PO or procurement contact, we’ll queue SOW + MOP generation.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-onprem-checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Emily / Mark — great, appreciate the clarity. Confirmed plan and next steps: 

A) Genomix: return completed site-inventory-template.xlsx by EOD Mon Jun 6. Confirmed maintenance window: Saturdays 02:00–06:00 PDT. Procurement contact: Mark Holden (cc).
B) Redwood: Ben will finalize the spare-parts recommendation and RMA options by Jun 4. Marissa will produce the offline MOP draft and the signed firmware bundle manifest once inventory is in hand.
C) Technical call: propose Tue Jun 8, 11:00 PDT (60 min) — Solutions Eng + Deploy Ops + Genomix infra to walk the inventory and agree final SOW milestones. I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the draft SOW + MOP link.

Links: Calendar invite (sent) — https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/sergio/genomix-onprem-0608
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-redwood-onprem
HubSpot: HS-567891

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
